title: fix: spill DreamShaper load across Vast workers
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
## What changed

- Bounds each DreamShaper Uvicorn process at one running and one waiting generation.
- Returns `503 Queue full` beyond that limit so the shared Vast pool router retries the other registered DreamShaper hostname.
- Persists `QUEUE_LIMIT=2` in Vast setup and documents the six-request-per-GPU admission limit.
- Adds focused tests for overload rejection and slot release after failures.

## Contract preserved

- Canonical model: `dreamshaper`; alias: `sana`
- Price multiplier: `1`; paid-only: no
- Pollinations GPU: yes; registry provider: Vast
- Primary: two-worker Vast `sana` pool running `Lykon/dreamshaper-8` with LCM LoRA
- External fallback: none

## Validation

- `python3 -m unittest -v test_server.py` — 2 passed
- `python3 -m py_compile server.py test_server.py`
- `bash -n setup-vast.sh`
- `npx vitest run test/image/availableServers.test.ts` — 9 passed

## Required rollout order

1. Merge this PR into `main`.
2. Sync `main` to `production` and deploy gen through GitHub Actions so the cross-worker 503 retry from #13218 is live.
3. Verify the deployed gen retry behavior.
4. Only then rerun setup on both DreamShaper production workers to activate `QUEUE_LIMIT=2`.

Enabling the worker queue limit before step 2 would expose raw 503s to users instead of failing over.

gist.headline: DreamShaper shares the pollen
gist.blurb: DreamShaper workers now know when their tiny waiting room is full and politely send new generations toward another Vast worker. Less queue staring, more pixels.
gist.summary: Bounded each DreamShaper Uvicorn worker to one active and one waiting generation (QUEUE_LIMIT=2), returning 503 Queue full so the shared Vast router can retry the other registered DreamShaper worker, for six admitted requests per GPU.
gist.impact: DreamShaper image requests can now spill across the two-worker Vast sana pool when one worker is busy, improving generation availability while preserving the dreamshaper/sana model contract.
